authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the owner's main session
authorization.text: On 2026-10-11 the owner chose 'release now, fix after' for Dyk release #483 (recorded on Dyk #483); the findings to fix are listed in Dyk #485. These tasks are bounded, principle-governed repairs of confirmed findings under the standing bounded repair authority of Dyk AGENTS.md section 4; they add no capability and change no owner-reserved matter. The owner's direction that agents keep working is recorded on netbka/engineering-platform#67 and Dyk #442 (2026-10-10). Four tasks, one worker at a time; PRs only, never merge or deploy; no production access. No limits (owner removed them); provider subscription limits and the no-progress guard are the stops. Provider order Claude, Codex, Cursor.

constraints: Campaign for netbka/Dyk#485 only. Each task is a bounded repair of the named findings on the named surface; do not redesign, add capabilities (PRINCIPLES F1) or change prices, plans, consent or other owner-reserved matters.

No production access, deployment, GitHub Actions, paid services, or Playwright and other browser-driven tests (Dyk owner rule). Local disposable SQL is allowed only through the repository runners (npm run test:sql / npm run journeys with a selected scope) when a task changes a route or persistence; never the production database.
Keep the affected Storybook stories in sync with any renderer change (Storybook is not post-hoc documentation). RU/EN/HE, true Hebrew RTL, 320/390 widths, 44px hit areas.
Never read .env contents, credentials, private conversations or real user data; fixtures are synthetic.
A Storybook build or passing tests is not visual acceptance; each PR lists the story ids for independent visual review and states that the visual verdict is pending.
Do not add any new blocking gate, lock, required approval or check that depends on owner-provisioned keys, credentials or setup (owner, 2026-10-10, Dyk AGENTS.md section 4).

tasks.title: Chats: Reset filters must never reach Not Found; truthful Telegram-connected-but-empty state
tasks.goal: Repair #485 must finding on production-chats--telegram-empty: with the Telegram filter already applied (e.g. right after connecting Telegram), 'Reset filters' (link, empty-state button and the Filters sheet's 'Show results') leads to a blank 'Not Found' page, while it works in production-chats--list. First establish whether the defect is in the product (route/query handling of the preset filter) or only in the Storybook fixture; fix the real owner. Also repair the related should finding on the same story: 'Telegram connected, no chats' is shown as 'No matches / Reset filters' with no explanation or next step; show the truthful state (T2) using existing copy patterns. Read gh issue view 485 --repo netbka/Dyk for the full finding text.
constraints: If the defect is in the product, add a focused contract (node/UI test or the selected HTTP journey) that fails before the fix.
acceptance: Reset filters returns the full list from every entry state, proven by a focused test that fails before the fix; the Telegram-empty state reads truthfully in RU/EN/HE.
Affected tests, npm run check:ui and npm run storybook:build pass, with exact commands.

tasks.title: Chats: plan-limit and read-only states say which chats are affected and offer the next step
tasks.goal: Repair #485 must finding on production-chats--over-limit (also design-chats--limit-read-only): the banner 'More chats are synchronized than your plan allows. Existing data is kept.' has no action and does not say which chats stopped syncing (DEAD_END). Also repair the related should findings: read-only rows and the reader lose their controls with no reason (production-chats--read-only, design reader-unavailable). Use existing data to name the affected chats and give one useful next step using existing destinations (the existing plans page or managing which chats are followed). Do not change prices, plan limits or billing behavior. Read gh issue view 485 --repo netbka/Dyk for the full finding text.
constraints: Only existing capabilities and destinations; if a genuinely new capability would be needed, stop and report it as a class D candidate instead of building it.
acceptance: The over-limit and read-only states name the affected chats and give one useful next action in RU/EN/HE; focused tests cover the state mapping.
Affected tests, npm run check:ui and npm run storybook:build pass, with exact commands.

tasks.title: Master design stage: tasks after setup show day/date grouping like production Tasks
tasks.goal: Repair #485 must finding on design-master--processing-partial (and the other processing-* stories): after setup is saved, the Tasks list shows tasks with no day or date, no Today/Tomorrow grouping and nothing opens, so the parent cannot see what is needed tomorrow (U14). The production Tasks renderer already groups by date and opens details; make the Design stage use the production Tasks renderer/fixtures rather than a simplified list (Storybook must not hold a second implementation), and fix the repeated labels nit on the same story. Storybook-only unless the production renderer itself is at fault.
constraints: Change storybook/ files only unless a production renderer defect is proven; keep exactly four dock destinations.
acceptance: The processing stories render the production Tasks grouping and open details; storybook node tests and npm run storybook:build pass, with exact commands.

tasks.title: Release review follow-ups: one Connect entry on the empty catalog, person link names, Summary layout without :has()
tasks.goal: Repair three should findings from the independent reviews of release #483: (1) production-chats--none shows two primary Connect rows plus the older 'Connect a messenger' empty-state link and search/Filters/'Found: 0' (three connect actions, D-066 no duplicate panels): keep one clear connect path and hide controls that cannot help on an empty catalog; (2) the Master overview person link's aria-label omits the context label, so two people with the same name get identical accessible names: include the context; (3) app/public/parent-ui.css uses `.d-bare:has(> .chatwrap){height:100%}`, the first layout rule depending on :has() (iOS < 15.4 / old Android WebView lose the Summary inner scroller): replace it with a server-rendered class on the Summary main and keep every other bare page unchanged. Read gh issue view 485 --repo netbka/Dyk and the PR comments on #477 and #480 for context.
constraints: Bounded repairs only; keep the Assistant composer pinned and every other bare page scrolling as today.
acceptance: Each of the three repairs has a focused test or guard; affected tests, npm run check:ui and npm run storybook:build pass, with exact commands.
